tools.name: screen_medication_gacc_customs_legality
tools.description: Match prescription brands, active ingredients, CAS numbers, RxNorm CUIs, Chinese names, or Russian/Japanese/Korean/Vietnamese aliases against 38 regulated entries under GACC Decree 442.

tools.name: calculate_medication_supply_allowance
tools.description: Compute whether carried medication quantities fall within legal Class I psychotropic (7-day), Class II (15-day), or maintenance prescription (90-day) caps relative to trip length.

tools.name: evaluate_caac_cabin_sharps_and_cold_chain
tools.description: Inspect Civil Aviation Administration of China cabin rules for insulin pens, EpiPen auto-injectors, medical needles, refrigerated cold packs, and doctor certificate requirements.

tools.name: generate_bilingual_china_pharmacy_card
tools.description: Produce printable simplified Mandarin doctor/pharmacist consultation notes, Pinyin pronunciation, domestic brand equivalents, and customs officer show-card fields for travelers in China.

tools.name: check_china_hospital_refill_and_clinic_pathway
tools.description: Determine if a foreign prescription can be legally re-prescribed inside Chinese Tier-3 hospitals or expat clinics, listing required department specialists, max refill days, and documentation.

tools.name: audit_multi_medication_travel_bag_manifest
tools.description: Evaluate an entire packed toiletry or travel bag containing multiple medications simultaneously to pinpoint any single banned trigger, aggregate Red Channel duties, and prepare a customs manifest.

tools.name: query_airport_red_channel_meds_walkthrough
tools.description: Look up customs pre-inspection CT lock procedures, exact Red Channel declaration counters, operating hours, and arrival baggage steps across PVG, PEK, CAN, and PKX international airports.

tools.name: lookup_therapeutic_substitute_mesh
tools.description: Traverse the curated 38-drug therapeutic similarity graph to surface legal Chinese-approved substitutes and side-by-side risk comparisons when a traveler’s primary prescription is prohibited or heavily restricted.
